documents.manuals/accessibility/reference.md:
# Accessibility walkthrough resources

Loan hearing receivers can be picked up from the west-side ticket desk.
Braille maps for the walkthrough are filed in a white envelope.
Staff collect returned receivers at the last stop of the tour.
documents.manuals/accessibility/related.md:
# Accessibility walkthrough resources

The main ticket desk keeps rental lanyards in a white box; the eastern desk collects visitor badges.
documents.manuals/bridge/reference.md:
# 河中过桥志愿者签到

过桥活动的志愿者在东岸的蓝棚签到。
每组领队需要在发放点领取两面安全旗。
活动结束后的物资清点由后勤协调员签字。
documents.manuals/bridge/related.md:
# 河中过桥志愿者签到

东岸的绿棚登记摄影人员，场馆活动的签到表归安保部门。
documents.manuals/camera/reference.md:
# Stop motion studio

Use the short camera stand when capturing overhead frames.
The spare memory card is stored underneath the labeled charging tray.
Record the first usable frame number on the paper shot sheet.
documents.manuals/camera/related.md:
# Stop motion studio

The tall camera stand is for portraits, and the spare battery sits in the red charging box.
documents.manuals/school/reference.md:
# 校史展解说录音

校史展解说录音的开头先报展品编号，再读标题。
用于现场播放的最终文件保存为 WAV。
访谈有杂音需要重录时，在文件名末尾加 -retake。
documents.manuals/school/related.md:
# 校史展解说录音

旧的宣传视频用 MP4 存档，历史照片的文件名以采集日期结尾。
documents.manuals/canteen/reference.md:
# Community canteen handover

Put the morning ingredient tally in the clipboard next to the pantry.
Leave the last unused meal voucher in the blue envelope.
When a serving spoon breaks, record the counter number on the repair sheet.
documents.manuals/canteen/related.md:
# Community canteen handover

The clipboard by the loading door tracks crate deliveries; the green envelope holds bus tickets.
documents.manuals/forest/reference.md:
# 森林课堂雨天转场

下雨时，森林课堂的标本观察移到入口服务站的连廊。
植物标本袋使用红色标签，石头样本袋使用黄色标签。
转场后，带队教师先清点学生再发放雨衣。
documents.manuals/forest/related.md:
# 森林课堂雨天转场

入口服务站的等候区可以领取雨伞；备用储物柜用绿色标签编号。
documents.manuals/printing/reference.md:
# Poster print queue

Draft posters are submitted in black and white.
Send approved color poster files to the layout coordinator.
Use a cardboard sleeve to carry finished posters down the stairs.
documents.manuals/printing/related.md:
# Poster print queue

Event flyers use a blue border, and the coordinator for room bookings distributes hallway signs.
documents.manuals/clinic/reference.md:
# 血压展示志愿者布置

健康讲座的血压演示只使用空袖带作为教具。
计时用的沙漏从右边的展示柜借用。
演示结束后，由器材志愿者收回道具并登记。
documents.manuals/clinic/related.md:
# 血压展示志愿者布置

大厅左边展示柜存放宣传册，展台志愿者负责归还桌牌。
documents.manuals/puppet/reference.md:
# Puppet stage setup

Attach the gray backdrop before the tabletop set is unfolded.
Clean the hand puppet handles with a dry microfiber cloth.
Store the extra backdrop pins in the narrow metal tin.
documents.manuals/puppet/related.md:
# Puppet stage setup

The blue backdrop is reserved for photos; the round tin stores batteries for the stage clock.
documents.manuals/garden/reference.md:
# 种子交换带走登记

领走交换种子前，把种子包装上的批次号记在登记簿。
潮湿的种子包用纸袋临时隔开，不放进塑料袋。
空的分装盒要交回门口的归还筐。
documents.manuals/garden/related.md:
# 种子交换带走登记

门口的蓝筐存放义工登记证；种子包装广告由主办方保留。
documents.manuals/memory/reference.md:
# Interview recording kit

Charge the field recorder using the short marked USB cable.
When an interview is interrupted, note the timestamp in the session log.
Return all clipped microphones to the padded zipper pouch.
documents.manuals/memory/related.md:
# Interview recording kit

The long USB cable powers the label printer; the large pouch holds site adapters.
documents.manuals/seal/reference.md:
# 展厅临时封条登记

玻璃展柜临时关闭时，在封条上写闭馆当天日期。
蓝色封条代表需等待复核，红色封条代表禁止开启。
用完的封条纸卷芯要送回值班台。
documents.manuals/seal/related.md:
# 展厅临时封条登记

蓝色标签用于展厅借出钥匙，入口台负责发告示牌。
documents.manuals/paint/reference.md:
# Mural repair intake

Record damage that reaches the primer on a yellow intake form.
Only the mural lead can approve a patch that changes a painted outline.
Put the reference photographs in the shared job folder.
documents.manuals/paint/related.md:
# Mural repair intake

A green form logs broken step stools; general workshop photographs go in the press folder.
documents.manuals/train/reference.md:
# 模型火车展台复位

模型火车展台停场前，先关闭主控电源，再取下无线控制器。
黄色机车进维修托盘，绿色机车回主轨停车位。
设备检查记录应放入展台下方第二个抽屉。
documents.manuals/train/related.md:
# 模型火车展台复位

展台下第一格放机车说明书，红色机车只用于摄影。
documents.manuals/firstaid/reference.md:
# Trail checkpoint supplies

Spare hydration cups are stacked behind the checkpoint flag.
Restock the first-aid box from the sealed supplies bin.
When calling in a trail blockage, give the marker number first.
documents.manuals/firstaid/related.md:
# Trail checkpoint supplies

The water jug is beside the signpost; the bin for loose gate clips is unsealed.
documents.manuals/pocket/reference.md:
# 自助物品柜的钥匙交接

交接自助物品柜的备用钥匙时，放进编号为 B 的信封。
归还钥匙的登记卡只写柜号和归还时间，不记录姓名。
发现不能转动的锁时，在状态面板写故障时间。
documents.manuals/pocket/related.md:
# 自助物品柜的钥匙交接

公用钥匙按值班组编号，工作人员抽屉里另备空信封。
documents.manuals/duet/reference.md:
# Outdoor concert changeover

Check the cable ramp before the second act begins.
Move unattended instrument cases behind the green curtain.
A red marker on the running order means the performers have signed in.
documents.manuals/duet/related.md:
# Outdoor concert changeover

The blue curtain covers maintenance shelves; the paper seating chart marks reserved rows in red.
documents.manuals/oxygen/reference.md:
# 潜水装备教学展位

模拟氧气瓶演示结束后，用灰色扎带束好气管。
展位的讲解页若被雨淋湿，由讲解负责人替换。
离开展位前，记录书由最后一名志愿者放回桌底托盘。
documents.manuals/oxygen/related.md:
# 潜水装备教学展位

黄色扎带用来固定展位的说明牌，讲解负责人领用备用纸张。
